title: Alert v1
description: A detector flagged a transaction. Published to the `alerts` Kafka topic, keyed by cardId. Mirrors io.budget.watchdog.schema.Alert; AlertContractTest keeps the two in sync. Publishing is at-least-once, so readers should drop duplicates by alertId. Unknown extra fields are allowed.

alertId.description: The same for the same transactionId and detector, so a republished alert keeps its ID.

detector.description: What raised it: a rule ID like duplicate-charge, or later a model's name.

detectedAt.description: Real time the watchdog raised the alert.
